about.title: About Me
paras: Self-taught software engineer based in London. I skipped university and learned by building — and haven't really stopped since.
These days I'm mostly writing Go, TypeScript and React at Sliide, building internal tooling.

I also take on freelance projects alongside my full-time role, usually marketing sites, web apps and internal tools for small teams. I handle the whole thing end to end, from figuring out what you need to getting it live. If that sounds useful, send me an email.

items.name: Embr Marketing Website
items.description: GDPR-compliant marketing site for a London-based fire curtain installation and maintenance specialist. Built with Astro, scoring 95+ across all Lighthouse metrics, and SEO-optimised to drive inbound leads. Microsoft Clarity wired up for behavioural insight, with Attio CRM integration handling form submissions.
infoNote: Login required — contact me for demo credentials.

secondaryImage.alt: embr fire protection home page hero

items.name: 3D/AR Product Viewer
items.description: A 3D & AR product viewer letting customers visualise products in their own space before buying. Built for Reydar and used by brands including Samsung, Howdens, HP and Ultimaker — rendering via google/model-viewer, with a Preact client and AWS S3/Lambda serving the models.
items.imageAlt: AR view-in-your-space QR prompt in the 3D product viewer

secondaryImage.alt: Saunders hygienic ball valve rendered in the 3D product viewer

items.name: Invoice App
items.description: A full CRUD invoice manager — create, edit, delete and filter invoices by status, with form validation, light/dark themes and a responsive layout. One of my earliest portfolio builds while learning web development.
infoNote: Login required — contact me for demo credentials.

timeline.title: Full Stack Engineer @ Sliide
intro: Part of the Centris internal tooling squad, building a configuration platform that lets teams set up and manage white-labelled app instances and create A/B tests without engineering involvement.

timeline.title: Technologist @ Eklipx
intro: Second engineering hire on a greenfield OTC derivatives platform letting dealers price, book, value, and manage the full lifecycle of structured products in real-time, with a white-label counterparty portal.

timeline.title: Full Stack Developer @ We Are Sweet
intro: Small team that developed an industry-first real-time second-screen experience for the PTO, winning the 2024 ISC Innovation Award. As well as development, I also managed on site operations for race days - putting sensors on athletes, swapping out faulty sensors and connecting sensors to our ingestion pipeline.

timeline.title: Front End Developer @ Engine Creative
intro: Developed a React-based 3D & AR product viewer letting users visualise products in their own space before buying - used by Samsung, Howdens, HP and Ultimaker.
